sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish

feed.title: Lockheed Martin lands $1B+ in new defense contracts
feed.summary: Lockheed Martin has secured over $1 billion in new and modified defense contracts from the Department of Defense. These contracts include funding for infrared tracking systems for Navy F/A-18 Super Hornet fighter jets, upgrades for F-35 fighter jets, missile-defense systems for Japanese warships, and electromechanical actuator units for U.S. Air Force F-16 fighter jets. feed.title: If You'd Invested $1,000 in Broadcom's 2009 IPO, Here's How Much You'd Have Today

This demonstrates the power of early investment and holding through market fluctuations, though future returns of this magnitude are unlikely given the company's current $1.7 trillion market cap.

feed.title: AbbVie Just Won FDA Approval for a Once-Daily Parkinson's Pill. Here's Why It Matters More Than You Think.
feed.summary: AbbVie recently received FDA approval for Juvmo (tavapadon), a new once-daily Parkinson's pill. This approval is significant as Juvmo is a key asset from AbbVie's $8.7 billion acquisition of Cerevel Therapeutics, designed to strengthen its neuroscience pipeline. The drug offers a new treatment option for Parkinson's patients by selectively activating D1/D5 dopamine receptors and is expected to contribute to AbbVie's growing neuroscience portfolio, with projected annual sales of $1.4 billion by 2040.
